name: Nepenthes
source:
A stolid buck looks into a string of disappearance sourced to the shell of the once famous Darlington Botanical Gardens. 

He discovers, however, that Darlington may not be so dormant as he initially thought.

[From [url=https://cetusotter.itch.io/nepenthes]Itch.io[/url]]
